title: Read-only exact-state node — Success
retry_policy: No retry required; a later refresh is a new observation attempt.
test_oracle: Exact task/repository/SHA/status is observed, persisted, and matches the requested binding.

title: Read-only exact-state node — Validation failure
retry_policy: Retry only with corrected immutable binding and a new attempt id.
test_oracle: No external observation is dispatched and no PASS is emitted.

title: Read-only exact-state node — Timeout before side effect
retry_policy: Retry the read with the same binding; record a new observation attempt.
test_oracle: No observation result exists; terminal PASS is forbidden.

title: Read-only exact-state node — Timeout after side effect
retry_policy: Re-observe because reads are non-mutating; preserve both attempt records.
test_oracle: Result is based on the resumed exact-state observation, not an unevidenced assumption.

title: Read-only exact-state node — Duplicate worker
retry_policy: Duplicate worker stops; owner continues.
test_oracle: Only the active lease holder may publish terminal evidence.

title: Read-only exact-state node — Stale checkpoint
retry_policy: Start a new run or reload the current checkpoint; never coerce stale bindings.
test_oracle: No observation is accepted under stale task/SHA/scope/graph revision.

title: Read-only exact-state node — Lease expiry
retry_policy: New owner performs a fresh observation; old owner is fenced.
test_oracle: Old worker cannot publish after expiry; fresh read determines result.

title: Read-only exact-state node — Ambiguous post-state
retry_policy: Retry observation or escalate; do not map unknown/pending to PASS or FAIL.
test_oracle: Terminal state remains non-PASS until exact state is observable.

title: Read-only exact-state node — Human takeover
retry_policy: Human may request fresh read or classify evidence; cannot authorize mutation.
test_oracle: Takeover packet contains exact binding, attempts, missing facts and allowed decisions.

title: Bounded external-write node — Success
retry_policy: No retry; duplicate requests with same key resolve to the same effect.
test_oracle: One intended external effect is confirmed by live-state readback under the same idempotency key and scope binding.

title: Bounded external-write node — Validation failure
retry_policy: Correct inputs and create a new attempt; do not persist or dispatch action intent.
test_oracle: Mutation call count is zero.

title: Bounded external-write node — Timeout before side effect
retry_policy: Retry only with the same idempotency key after readback proves no effect.
test_oracle: Zero live effect before retry; intent remains durable.

title: Bounded external-write node — Timeout after side effect
retry_policy: If readback confirms effect, do not retry; if absent, retry same key; if inconclusive, suspend.
test_oracle: Exactly one live effect; lost response cannot cause duplicate dispatch.

title: Bounded external-write node — Duplicate worker
retry_policy: Duplicate worker exits; duplicate key is rejected/deduplicated by store and provider.
test_oracle: External mutation count is one and stale fencing token writes are zero.

title: Bounded external-write node — Stale checkpoint
retry_policy: Reload checkpoint and reconcile pending_action before any dispatch.
test_oracle: No new mutation occurs from a stale revision.

title: Bounded external-write node — Lease expiry
retry_policy: New owner readbacks first; stale owner response may be recorded but cannot advance checkpoint.
test_oracle: Fencing rejects old owner checkpoint writes and prevents second external effect.

title: Bounded external-write node — Ambiguous post-state
retry_policy: No automatic retry. Human chooses confirm-applied, confirm-not-applied/retry-same-key, or abort.
test_oracle: PASS and repeat dispatch are both forbidden while readback is ambiguous.

title: Bounded external-write node — Human takeover
retry_policy: Only bounded decisions in takeover packet; any manual corrective mutation needs separate authority.
test_oracle: Packet includes intent hash, idempotency key, request/response, readback, lease and checkpoint evidence.

title: Durable checkpoint/CAS/lease/resume node — Success
retry_policy: No retry; resume uses persisted next node and exact binding.
test_oracle: Checkpoint revision advances exactly once under the active lease/fencing token and resume preserves all bindings.

title: Durable checkpoint/CAS/lease/resume node — Validation failure
retry_policy: Correct missing/invalid run, checkpoint, revision, binding or clock fields.
test_oracle: No lease or checkpoint mutation occurs.

title: Durable checkpoint/CAS/lease/resume node — Timeout before side effect
retry_policy: Retry CAS only after reload proves revision unchanged.
test_oracle: Checkpoint revision advances zero times.

title: Durable checkpoint/CAS/lease/resume node — Timeout after side effect
retry_policy: Treat matching advanced revision as success; never blindly repeat CAS.
test_oracle: Checkpoint revision advances exactly once despite lost acknowledgment.

title: Durable checkpoint/CAS/lease/resume node — Duplicate worker
retry_policy: Loser reloads and stops or follows next persisted node.
test_oracle: One successful CAS; no two owners share a valid fencing token.

title: Durable checkpoint/CAS/lease/resume node — Stale checkpoint
retry_policy: Reload current revision; reject mismatched task/repo/SHA/scope/graph/node version.
test_oracle: Stale revision never overwrites current state.

title: Durable checkpoint/CAS/lease/resume node — Lease expiry
retry_policy: New owner receives higher fencing token; old owner is permanently rejected.
test_oracle: Every post-takeover write carries the new token and old-token rowcount is zero.

title: Durable checkpoint/CAS/lease/resume node — Ambiguous post-state
retry_policy: No continuation or side-effect retry until checkpoint and live state can be read.
test_oracle: No false next-node advancement during store ambiguity.

title: Durable checkpoint/CAS/lease/resume node — Human takeover
retry_policy: Manual ownership transfer requires audit, expiry/force policy, new fence and reconciliation.
test_oracle: Human cannot silently overwrite active lease or skip pending-action readback.
